description.value:
When you enter your rage, you may choose up to five allies you can see within 30 feet, and you gain 5 temporary hit points for each of them. For the rest of the rage, once on each of their turns, an affected ally may add your rage damage bonus to a weapon attack's damage roll.

You can call on this ability five times, gaining a sixth use at 17th level, and all expended uses return after a long rest.
